text: small. I picked this up for one small child in my classroom, thought it would make a great break chair.  She really loves it and it's the right size, the only thing I don't like is it doesn't keep it's shape real well.  It really needed more stuffing.

product_metadata.title: Posh Creations Pasadena Bean Bag Toddlers and Kids, Comfy Chair for Children, Soft Nylon-Pink
features: GREAT FOR KIDS: This small bean bag chair is the perfect size for toddlers and kids to claim as their own piece of furniture
YOUR FAVORITE CHAIR, JUST SMALLER: Perfectly scaled down for kids, the Pasadena Chair has all the features you love on an adult chair, but it's just the right size for toddlers and children.

CONVENIENT HANDLE AND POCKET: Kids are always in control of where they want to sit when they have this lightweight chair with an easy-transport handle. The side pocket is the perfect place for storing books, games and snacks for your little ones.
FILLED WITH SOFT BEANS: Every bean bag chair is filled with just enough polystyrene beans so that it's both soft and supportive
EASY CLEAN FABRIC: Our EZ Clean fabric means you never have to worry about spills or accidents ruining your new favorite chair. Just wipe clean and it's as good as new!
description: Little kids deserve a place to relax as well, and it doesn't get any better than the Pasadena bean bag chair. Our kids chair is the perfect size for toddlers and kids, and features thoughtful details like a side pocket for all of their books and games. The top handle makes it easy for them to carry this lightweight chair from room to room, and mom and dad will love how simple it is to wipe up any spills from the easy care fabric. The perfect accent chair for family rooms, bedrooms and game rooms, let the Pasadena Chair become the ideal snuggling spot for your little one
